# Where to find and how to farm for Royal Jelly in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Aug 8, 2023
- 2 min read

Updated: Dec 17, 2023

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_aedc8c562c9b4edba569f12af8ed5c89~mv2.jpg)

With thanks to Jamie MachinegunGOGO and Cassi.

Used for:

- Tadpole Badge: Cook - Cook Blackberry Honey Crisp
- Blackberry Honey Crisp
- Royal Jelly Taffy

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a6c271ba52784c5b836d0234115984bf~mv2.jpg)

__Farming Tips and Tricks__

Royal Jelly is a player cell activated, per server spawn, pick up history list item. If you don't know what any of that means, please have a read over my how spawns work __guide__ first. 

There are two types of Royal Jelly in game.

**Junk Version**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6867dbccfa2b47cda7c095279ae688d2~mv2.jpg)

The junk version has one in-game spawn and can be put in a display case. It also drops from Honeybeasts.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_56622ad1b42b4dbf9075207a0bde5a3f~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ebb83ebb6f7e4aab96aa509df3d9ef76~mv2.jpg)

**Aid Version**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a73f463ca7174247a4d5ccc04504cf47~mv2.jpg)

The aid version is used for cooking and can be found in the below locations. The aid version does not drop from Honeybeasts.

__Fixed Spawn Locations__

**Tanagra Town**

1x Royal Jelly Spawn

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d7d3e09e91454d3a91ca068d5e37265d~mv2.jpg)

Climb up to the top of the tree. In the second house, on the very top level, in the bathtub.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f82f65b82ce3477d81c5288333f3e2e0~mv2.jpg)

**Middle Mountain Pitstop**

4x Royal Jelly

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b373340de0e84cf68b8789b9023a1b84~mv2.jpg)

1x Royal Jelly

On top of the blue truck trailer near the front fence. Under the table, next to the green ammo box.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_eb92e113346f4bd7b2f99799abdeb7a5~mv2.jpg)

1x Royal Jelly

Out the front of the General Store, on the wooden crate, next to the blue junk trailer.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_15566667d3894d49a0a153572bf07e61~mv2.jpg)

1x Royal Jelly

On the roof of The Boozin Brahmin, on the patio table.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bc9f48cdd1f94a118258664d40616bca~mv2.jpg)

1x Royal Jelly

Inside the Sleep Stop, in the Southern corner of the building, under the bunk bed.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b9198bcc53a04fd28547844b54b3f4e6~mv2.jpg)

**Mountainside Bed & Breakfast**

3x Royal Jelly

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8c8e003ce2d5486ea1444e56206b3e3e~mv2.jpg)

1x Royal Jelly

Enter the building via the North door on the ground floor. The door is next to where the Overseer got attacked by the Mole Miners. On the wooden table against the right wall, next to the phone on the wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5e35aafb17cf4b5e919f16a7b30fe328~mv2.jpg)

1x Royal Jelly

Inside the building, in the NE corner of the kitchen, on the countertop.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_af6b41eb2ac84cdbafa4ded04d8dc419~mv2.jpg)

1x Royal Jelly

Upstairs, in the lounge area, on the bottom shelf of the cabinet, on the Western side of the room.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_26cc7fcdc22e4060881bd26962848ac4~mv2.jpg)

__Vendors/Camp Allies/NPC's/Collectrons__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_32e76cb4d46a4dd6b170f963fc726871~mv2.png)

__Fasnacht Collectron__ - 6.25%
